description: Comune di Seriate publishes road-incident records labelled 2000–2013. The native field schema names year, date, time, location, incident type, uninjured/injured/deceased counts, pedestrians, bicycles, motorcycles/mopeds, heavy vehicles and longitude/latitude. These are declared fields only; actual observation dates, populated coordinates and reported totals were not inspected. The source-labelled period is retained without claiming that every year is complete or that the listing is currently updated. Event values, positional accuracy and current coverage remain unverified. Coverage is Seriate, Italy. The source declares the CC BY 4.0 licence and CSV access links. Metadata are public; later file-use costs and completeness remain unknown. No specific simulation application is documented. Related tables are grouped by the named publisher, police/incident subject and stated period; unrelated municipal datasets are not included.
